# Netscape HTTP Cookie File
# A cookies file that DOES carry a session. The session rows are the HttpOnly
# ones, which is why a reader that skips every `#` line sees this file as empty.
# Values are placeholders, never real cookies.
#HttpOnly_.youtube.com	TRUE	/	TRUE	1799999999	SID	placeholder-session-value
#HttpOnly_.youtube.com	TRUE	/	TRUE	1799999999	__Secure-1PSID	placeholder-session-value
.youtube.com	TRUE	/	TRUE	1799999999	VISITOR_INFO1_LIVE	placeholder-visitor-cookie
.youtube.com	TRUE	/	FALSE	1799999999	PREF	f6=40000000
